## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down survival horror game, “The Last Shift,” set at a remote gas station during an overnight shift.

## Requirements
- Explore the station and nearby area; manage power, generator fuel, cameras, objects, customers, and mysterious events.
- Include fog/darkness, timer, inventory, flashlight battery, simple environmental puzzles, multiple endings, and keyboard plus mobile touch controls.
- Finish the game without clarification; briefly note assumptions when complete.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript browser game without external dependencies.
- Used a canvas-rendered station map and six-hour shift timer; movement uses arrow keys or touch buttons, with E/interact, C/cameras, and F/flashlight.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game interface, responsive styling, canvas map, movement and touch controls, inventory/object pickups, generator/power and flashlight systems, camera overlay, story events, objectives, and ending paths.
- Added files `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.

### Active
- Validate the latest game logic and rendering in-browser; earlier browser testing exposed an immediate premature ending, which was corrected by replacing the game logic.
- Confirm keyboard/touch controls and ending conditions work after the latest changes.

### Blocked
- Browser check initially failed because the server was not running; it was started and the browser opened successfully.
- The first implementation ended immediately due to treating the displayed 10 PM clock as 10 hours elapsed. The game loop was rewritten to use `world.timeMinutes`; the corrected version has not yet been retested.

## Next Move
1. Retest the latest `game.js` in-browser and check for runtime errors and premature endings.
2. Verify core progression: pick up fuel, refuel generator, find key, unlock office, then reach either ending.
3. Save and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot; fix any visible or gameplay issues.
4. Report completion and mention reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile layout.
- `game.js`: Game state, rendering, controls, resource management, interactions, and endings.
- `/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime/scripts/default-start.mjs`: Runtime expects a static `index.html`; `start.sh` invokes this script.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright`: Playwright package used for the successful browser check.

## Important Context
- Repository changes are uncommitted.
- A local Python HTTP server was launched on port 3000; the earlier successful Playwright check used `http://localhost:3000`.
- Before the rewrite, testing showed “Ending reached” and “Sunrise arrives” almost immediately; the corrected `game.js` changed the clock to minute-based progression.
